artifacts.summary: 3-phase plan (3h) wiring web -> typescript: content split plus coupled line_count regeneration, web-agent context pointers, manifest dependency plus end-to-end deploy/unload verification.

memory_candidates.content: suite_selection_select (scripts/lib/suite-selection-lib.sh) does NOT return the union of per-path suite lists for a multi-path phase: if ANY one touched path maps to no suite, the whole selection collapses to the __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel. A plan phase mixing a markdown/context file (no mapped suite) with a code/JSON file (real suites) therefore CANNOT honestly name those real suites in its **Tier Justification** -- validate-artifact.sh compares the justification's suite names against the selector's output over the phase's whole path set and flags the mismatch as a fabricated claim. The honest form for such a mixed phase is the plan-format __FULL_SWEEP__ sub-case (b) gate subset: `verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4 <repo_root>` with the repo root (the directory holding .claude-extensions.json) as TARGET, keeping any per-path suite run as an explicitly supplementary check rather than the declared covering one.
